scanNetwork: Could not reach the {{platform}} app registration service. Check your network.
scanUnsupported: This {{platform}} environment does not support creating apps by QR code. Use manual setup.
authFailed: Could not verify {{platform}} app credentials. Copy App ID and App Secret again from Credentials & Basic Info and check your network.
tenantFailed: Could not obtain the {{platform}} tenant ID. Enable Get tenant information and publish the app, or enter the actual Tenant Key in Advanced settings.
botFailed: Could not obtain the bot ID. Add the Bot capability, publish the app, then try again.
socketFailed: Could not connect to {{platform}}. Check the app region, App ID and App Secret. Lark apps require the Lark region; remove and recreate the connection if the region is wrong. Enable the bot, then configure persistent connection events.
eventStorage: Could not save the IM event. Check Gateway storage.
connectionRemoved: This connection ID was removed. Use a new connection ID.
connectionIdentity: This connection ID is bound to a platform, tenant and bot. Use a new ID for a different bot to keep historical messages from reaching another account.
cardRetry: Approval card update is pending retry. Check message update permissions and your network.
typingRetry: Could not update the typing indicator. Check message reaction permissions and your network.
interrupted: Delegation interrupted; this task has ended
approvalInvalid: This confirmation is invalid, already handled or expired. Use your own direct chat or Artemis desktop.
ownerConfirmation: Waiting for this Agent's owner to confirm. The owner must respond in Artemis or the bot's direct chat before the task continues.
ownerDesktop: Waiting for the owner to confirm in Artemis desktop.
cardFallback: Card buttons are unavailable. Use the text commands below.
beforeStartCancelled: Assignment cancelled before the local task started.
taskComplete: Task completed. View the results in Artemis.
requestExpired: Request expired. Please send it again.
queueExpired: The queued request expired without starting a task. Send it again to continue.
scopeExpired: This task's data or sharing scope is no longer valid. Confirm it on the desktop and start a new restricted task.
heldResult: The result is held for review in Artemis desktop and has not been sent.
failedDesktop: Request incomplete. Check Artemis desktop for details.
pairRequested: Pairing requested. Approve it in Artemis messaging settings.
paired: Paired. Send /projects to choose a project or /help for commands.
pairDenied: Pairing denied. Generate a new pairing code in Artemis to try again.
pairRequired: Generate a pairing code in Artemis IM connection settings, then send /pair followed by the code.
memberDenied: The bot owner has blocked your account from assigning tasks in this group. Ask the owner to update member permissions.
groupDiscovered: Group discovered. In Artemis → Messaging → Groups, refresh the list and confirm the project and sharing scope. Enable the group, then resend your task; this message will not execute.
memberNotAuthorized: You are not authorized to assign tasks to this bot. Ask the owner to authorize your account in Artemis group settings. No task will start.
ownerCommands: Group members may submit, query or stop their own tasks. Only the bot owner may switch projects or approve actions.
offline: The target Artemis is offline or paused. Your request is queued. Open Artemis on the computer and enable IM; authorization will be checked again on reconnect. This request expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
manualOnly: Assign tasks by mentioning the target bot in the same IM group. Cross-group spaces and shared Gateway delegation have been retired.
retryQueued: Delegation retry confirmed. It will run when the task is idle.
waitResumed: Waiting resumed. No task has been delegated again.
waitStopped: Local waiting stopped. Late results will not resume this task automatically; the peer's task has not been cancelled.
noProjects: No projects added. Send a message to start a temporary task using Execute and local Artemis permissions, or open a project in Artemis first.
noGrantedProjects: No projects authorized. Set project permissions for this group in Artemis.
unsubscribed: Updates from the current task will no longer be sent to this conversation.
noActiveCancel: There is no task to cancel.
noActiveQuery: There is no task to query.
selected: Selected {{name}}. New progress will be sent to this conversation.
handoffHistory: The original history stays on the desktop; only the handoff text you explicitly selected is imported.
queuedRequest: The task is running or starting. This request is queued; authorization will be checked again when the task is idle.
fileQueued: {{name}} is queued for delivery in this IM conversation. SHA-256: {{hash}}
fileReview: The file is held for desktop review and has not been uploaded.
linkExpiry: The link expires in 15 minutes. Do not forward it beyond the authorized audience.
nativeAccepted: Task saved; waiting for local execution.
peerDenied: The bot owner has blocked this member from assigning tasks.
waitTimeout: Waiting timed out. The peer’s status is unknown; it may still be running.
waitInterrupted: This task has ended and will not be delegated again automatically. Choose an action in Artemis, or send /retry {{id}} to delegate again.
deliveryExpired: The task expired or its authorization was revoked. It was not delivered to the desktop executor.
approvalShared: Submitted. Desktop and IM share the same one-time confirmation.
help:
/projects — List available projects
/project <project ID> — Switch project
/new <task> — Start a new task
/tasks — List tasks
/continue <task ID> — Select and subscribe to a task
/status [task ID] — Show status
/stop [task ID] — Stop a task
/retry <wait ID> — Confirm delegation again
/stopwait <wait ID> — Stop local waiting without cancelling the peer task
/wait <wait ID> — Keep waiting when the peer’s status is unknown
/approve <code> yes|no — Handle approval
/answer <code> [question ID] <answer> — Answer a question
/publish [task ID] <relative path> — Publish a selected file (15-minute link)
/unsubscribe — Stop updates to this conversation
Direct chats, including temporary tasks, use Execute and local Artemis permissions by default. Groups accept assignments only from authorized accounts that mention the bot. Reply to a bot message and mention it to continue that task. For a handoff, mention the next bot in the same IM group and include a summary. Group conversations show messages and tasks involving this bot.
deliveryInterrupted: The desktop was interrupted during task delivery. To avoid repeating external actions, the task was not replayed. Check /status before explicitly continuing.
fileQueuedStatus: The file is queued for delivery in this IM conversation. Check the group chat for platform receipt status.
resumeDelegation: The delegated IM result has arrived. Continue using the latest instructions.
identityUnpaired: Pair your own IM account first.
waitIdRequired: Enter the wait ID shown in the message.
projectIdRequired: Use the full project ID from /projects.
ownerApprovalOnly: Handle approvals and questions in your own direct chat or on the desktop.
approvalCodeInvalid: The confirmation code is invalid, already handled or expired.
approvalTaskExpired: The approval task is no longer available.
questionIdRequired: Specify the question ID provided by the bot.
confirmationMismatch: The confirmation code does not match this action.
publishHttps: File download links require an accessible HTTPS Gateway. Connect to a team service or deploy a standalone Gateway before publishing.
publishUsage: Use /publish [task ID] <project-relative path>. The link lasts 15 minutes and is visible to everyone in this conversation.
binaryFileReview: This file cannot be inspected as plain text. Review it on the desktop.
taskStarting: The task is starting. Try continuing from IM shortly.
desktopBusy: Wait for the desktop task to finish before taking over through IM.
unknownCommand: Unknown command. Send /help for available commands.
selectionUnavailable: The linked conversation is unavailable. Explicitly select the task to continue.
projectRequired: Use /projects to list projects, then /project <project ID> to select one.
taskDeleted: The task was deleted. Send a new message to create a task.
attachmentTooLarge: The attachment exceeds the 10 MiB size limit.
threadIdentityMismatch: The task belongs to another identity or conversation.
continueExplicit: In your own direct chat, use /continue <task ID> to explicitly select a desktop task.
selfTasksOnly: You can only query or stop your own tasks in this conversation.
attachmentSizeLimit: The attachments exceed the size limit.
